newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania's 1996 zinc output seen at 29,500 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Romania's 1996 zinc output seen at 29,500 tonnes.

text.p: Romania expects to produce some 29,500 tonnes of zinc this year, slightly more than in 1995, the industry ministry said on Tuesday.
January-September zinc output totalled 19,500 tonnes, one percent up on the same period last year, data issued by the ministry showed.
In 1995 Romania's zinc production was 29,200 tonnes, some 10,700 more than in 1994.
Higher output at the country's only zinc smelter, Sometra SA at Copsa Mica in central Transylvania, followed extensive upgrading and restructuring.
Two production units at Sometra were closed in 1990 to solve serious environmental problems. The 1996 zinc output would go to local industry as exports are banned under existing rules.
